reasons.text: The label photo is shared with another claim in the program (same image hash), so this claim is flagged for review as a possible duplicate.
The label is legible and shows model 200LX, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The typed serial QQ19420553 falls outside the recalled serial ranges. This would be a denial on its own, but the duplicate flag takes precedence.
The purchase date of 2018-09-25 is inside the sale window, and no receipt is required for this claim, so the purchase rule is satisfied.
